# FOO 0.2.3

**Release type:** FOO

**Git tag:** `foo-v0.2.3`

FOO 0.2.3 makes managed Zig setup visible from start to finish. Installation
now reports the target, destination, size, download progress and rate, checksum
verification, extraction, installation, and final executable verification.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the complete release notes.
